Messages.Author: Raille
Messages.Body:
Couple Questions

Card Text:
When Tyler diablerizes a vampire, she untaps and gains a blood from the
blood bank. Once per turn, she may burn a blood to get +1 bleed or an
additional vote.

With the Rown Ring text: Send the opposing vampire to torpor as a strike.
This card is transferred to that vampire, and he or she doesn't untap as
normal during the untap phase as long as he or she remains in torpor.

The questions I have are:

Situation:

Tyler strikes with the Ring sending the opposing vampire to torpor. Tyler
Now plays Amaranth the opposing minion, who currently holds the Rowen ring.
The opposing vampire then plays Ashes to Ashes to prevent being burned.

Does this count as a successful Diablery, so that Tyler can untap?

Does the opposing minion keep the Rowen ring.

Do retainers get burned on the opposing minion.

In a similar situation, the opposing minion plays Undead Persistance to
prevent going to torpor.

Does the opposing minion now have the ring to use against Tyler?
